method: First compared all 118 technical and all 118 composed linguistic snapshot files against parent-frozen files where available and otherwise the then-current worktree: all matched before concurrent search edits. Reconstructed that exact pre-SEO metadata/catalog/source state and recomputed all baseline review triples with the captured prior reviewInputs implementation. Later concurrent changes to DocsSearch.astro and search-terms.mjs were detected, read as a separate delta with their new JS/TS/concept/generator dependencies, and are separately fingerprinted. Hash equality establishes continuity only; completed prior review judgments and new source judgments are the review evidence.
staleRegistrationFinding: Before SEO editing, content-reviews.json still referenced older evidence digests and input triples. Both latest independent source reports already match the reconstructed pre-SEO state in all 384 comparisons. This review inherits those verified reports, not the stale registration records. It does not erase the old reports or change prior issue history.
concurrentFreshnessLimit: The current content-review input closure does not automatically cover all newly introduced non-Astro search dependencies. Their exact independently inspected bytes are recorded here for final manual digest verification. This source review does not certify future changes to those files or claim the new UI/search results have been executed.
